Within-seed interaction covariance and distinct founder references.
Capture, poison, miss, ordinary, guard and extinction decomposition with480-unit frozen accounting.
Frozen births/deaths/late-birth/composition/cell-time invariants, while guarded/extinct pairs retain fitness.
Not-started, incomplete, running and failed study gates read no partial outcomes.
